method: FOSSGIS OSRM pedestrian network routes, full GeoJSON; measured parts only, not guaranteed daily totals.
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; pedestrian routing FOSSGIS / OSRM
rateLimit: One-off sequential public landmarks, ≥1.15 seconds between requests; raw routes cached; no runtime requests.
timeModel: 4 km/h moving time only; add visits, rests, slopes, bridge steps and transfers.
exclusions: Unknown hotel legs including Mestre versus Santa Lucia
Boat, bus, rail, taxi, funicular transfers
limitations: Network planning estimates, not live access guarantees. Closures, ice, private access and flooding override route.
Lakeshore shaping points are planning anchors snapped by OSRM.
Initial Pisani Gritti hotel geocode corrected to concert conservatory.
